usage: As a noun, '行山' means the activity of hiking, e.g., 'I enjoy going for a hike on weekends.'
As a verb phrase, '行山' means to go hiking, e.g., 'We plan to hike this Saturday.'
It can be used with verbs like '去' (to go) when talking about the action of going hiking.
When talking about frequency, '行山' can be combined with words like '經常' (often) or '試下' (try) to express regularity or suggestion.
The phrase can appear in questions, statements, and commands naturally, making it versatile for different sentence types.
